data.body: REVIEW (cold, fresh context): PASS with two trivial inline fixes. Verified: (1) Contract — JS is a SITES['8bit'] registry function, all queries via root.querySelector(All), listeners only on stage/dpad buttons inside root, no window/document handlers (matchMedia read + ResizeObserver on .cabinet element only), root never styled, standalone boot at end of body; CSS has @import at top with no raw ';' in URL, only @import/@media/@keyframes at-rules, eightbit- prefixed keyframes, no commas in functional pseudo-classes, no display on html/body, no conflicting html/body props, no ids at all so no id collisions, no literal </style> or </script>. (2) Map/markup cross-check — BFS over the 16x11 MAP confirms spawn (8,9) walkable and all three door thresholds (2,2)/(7,2)/(12,2) reachable; bush/rock coords, river rows 5-6 cols 1-14, bridge col 7, path col 7 rows 7-9, gates at cols 1-3/6-8/11-13 with G/T/E doors at row 1 cols 2/7/12 all match markup exactly; critter loop cols 9-13 row 9 all walkable. (3) JS logic — threshold py-1 lookup, tap-to-turn, 2-frame half-step (64ms mid + settle ~ 128ms), enter() half-tile step then door.click() at 200ms (native nav, mailto included), preventDefault only on handled keys (arrows+wasd, case-insensitive), focus/blur prompt swap + held-key clearing, coin counter starts/stops with focus, dpad pointer press/release/cancel/leave, ResizeObserver integer --px = max(1, floor(min(w/256, h/224))), reduced-motion zeroes timeouts and disables critter. node --check passes. (4) Fidelity — all colors in the 16-entry palette (verified every SVG data-URI hex), no gradients/border-radius/transition/opacity<1 except 0.06 scanline, Press Start 2P sizes at 8px multiples, HUD per section 9, doors are real anchors with aria-labels, sr-only note present, decorative elements aria-hidden, dpad buttons tabindex=-1 inside aria-hidden container. Inline fixes: focused prompt 'ARROWS MOVE' -> 'ARROWS MOVE - UP ENTERS' (brief section 9 prompt spec, ASCII-adapted since Press Start 2P lacks arrow/middot glyphs), and sr-only note now leads with 'Forrest Almasi, software developer' since the HUD wordmark is aria-hidden and the name was otherwise absent from the accessible body. Noted, not changed: wordmark shadow is navy rather than the brief's Cabinet Black — black-on-black would be invisible on the void HUD ground, navy is on-palette and deliberate; --px is set on .cabinet not .stage so the bezel dpad scales too — element inside root, contract-clean. Acceptance criteria met; recommend done.

Generated 8bit/index.html, style.css, script.js from BRANDING.md via brand-page skill. Review passed (2 inline fixes: prompt copy, sr-only name). Left uncommitted per brand-page skill scope; sites.config.json untouched — bucket mapping is a human decision.
